verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll, EOR and contractor-management platform, not an agent or AI assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The evidence shows Remote acting as an MCP server for external clients like Claude Code and Cursor. That is server-side and does not make this client-side story applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
